data.title: World's largest humanoid robot maker Unitree's founder becomes billionaire ahead of IPO - VnExpress International
data.description: Wang Xingxing, chairman and CEO of Unitree Robotics, the world's largest humanoid robot maker by shipments, has become China's first humanoid robot billionaire ahead of the company's Shanghai listing.
